simple.meaning: גָּבָהּ (gâbâhh) is a Hebrew word meaning “lofty (literally or figuratively).” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: גָּבָהּ (H1362) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Psalms 101:5, with occurrences in Psalms, Proverbs, Ecclesiastes, Ezekiel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to גָּבָהּ (H1362) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in גָּבָהּ (H1362) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: גָּבָהּ (gâbâhh) / H1362 is traced through Psalms 101:5, Proverbs 16:5, Ecclesiastes 7:8, Ezekiel 31:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
